items.title: Turn a Spreadsheet into Charts with Python (pandas + matplotlib) | Beginner Tutorial
items.description:
Turn an Excel spreadsheet into a line chart, a bar chart, a pie chart and a full dashboard with a few lines of Python. Step by step for beginners, with every script run for real and the three errors that stop almost everyone (and how to fix them).

Chapters
0:00 The result
0:34 The plan
0:49 Why not just use Excel charts?
1:09 Install the tools
1:33 The practice spreadsheet
1:50 Step 1: read the spreadsheet
2:44 Step 2: your first line chart
3:20 Step 3: make it look professional
4:19 Step 4: a bar chart of totals
5:04 Step 5: a pie chart
5:37 Common errors
6:40 Bonus: add a Total column
7:06 Step 6: one dashboard, one image
7:39 Pro tip: one-word chart types
7:57 Recap

Install (free):
pip install pandas matplotlib openpyxl

The practice file sales.xlsx has 4 columns: Month, Coffee, Tea, Cakes (12 months, first row = column names).

Full dashboard script from the video (charts.py, Python 3.11, pandas 3.1.1, matplotlib 3.11.2):
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_excel("sales.xlsx")
products = ["Coffee", "Tea", "Cakes"]
totals = df[products].sum()

fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 5))

df.plot(x="Month", y=products, marker="o", ax=ax1)
ax1.set_title("Monthly sales by product")
ax1.set_xlabel("")

totals.plot(kind="bar", rot=0, ax=ax2, color=["#8B5A2B", "#4C9A2A", "#E07A9B"])
ax2.set_title("Total sales in the year")
ax2.bar_label(ax2.containers[0])

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("dashboard.png", dpi=150)
print("Saved dashboard.png")
plt.show()

Pie chart (pie_chart.py):
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_excel("sales.xlsx")
totals = df[["Coffee", "Tea", "Cakes"]].sum()
ax = totals.plot(kind="pie", autopct="%1.0f%%", figsize=(6, 6))
ax.set_ylabel("")
ax.set_title("Share of the year's sales")
plt.savefig("pie.png", dpi=150)
plt.show()

Common errors:
ImportError: `Import openpyxl` failed  -  run: pip install openpyxl
FileNotFoundError: 'sales.xlsx'  -  cd into the folder that has the file
KeyError: 'coffee'  -  column names must match exactly (print(df.columns))
Blank image  -  call plt.savefig() BEFORE plt.show()
